Order only.

A Fury warrior's off-hand weapon hits for half a main hand's swing. Pawn weighs a warrior's off-hand weapon as its main hand, 5.22. Pawn's own rogue off-hand scale weighs an off-hand weapon at 2/3 of the main hand for a rogue whose off hand deals 75% (its Dual Wield Specialization at 50%). The warrior's 50% at that rate is 5.22 x 2/3 x 50/75, for 2.32. Dual Wield Specialization adds to it by rank in the fix after this one.
